messages:
olivia: Quick shoutout  NorthWave Retail went live on the AWS Marketplace this morning and selected Redwood Dedicated for inference. Onboarding complete! :tada:

matt: Amazing news. Any quick perf highlights from the pilot?

keisha: Pilot summary: search relevance improved (MRR up ~12%) after switching to our rerank model + prefix cache; batch embedding throughput increased ~2x. They deployed reserved Dedicated in us-east-1.

raj: Ops note: they required BYOK + 90-day audit log retention. INF-4724 created and assigned. Also enabled VPC peering and mutual TLS.

ops-bot: AWS Marketplace listing is live: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/NORTHWAVE-RETAIL status=ACTIVE.

marketing: Heads-up marketing will draft a short customer case + social posts. Need a 1-2 sentence quote and a one-paragraph technical note.

olivia: I'll book a 10-min quote call with their CTO for tomorrow at 11am ET. Also requested written consent for the quote.

keisha: Tiny tech snippet for the engineering blog:

```
redwood.create_pool(
  name="northwave-dedicated",
  region="us-east-1",
  instances=5,
  model="rerank-3b",
  cache_prefixing=true,
  quant_variant="int8"
)
```

design: Pinged design for a small infra diagram (DGN-874).

matt: Sales asked to add NorthWave as a reference for retail customers. Ref ID: REF-NW-02. Added to CRM.

marketing: Draft uploaded to Google Drive; sharing for review by EOD. Congrats team! :rocket:
